firm_data.firm_description: J&G Law, LLP has been providing legal services in New York for nearly 60 years, combining legal remedies with client service. They offer counsel to individuals, families, municipalities, and businesses on a wide range of legal issues.
notable_facts: The firm has nearly 60 years of experience.
They have a team of 20 attorneys.
Full-service legal representation in over 30 areas of practice

email.subject: AI for J&G Law - built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Kelly,

With nearly 60 years serving Monticello clients across municipal law, business counsel, and complex transactions, J&G Law has built something most firms can't: deep local trust paired with serious practice depth.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now expanding to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your office on Thursday, April 10 to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
